name: ui-tap
prompt: Short soft UI tap click, like a fingertip tapping a small plastic button, dry and close

name: rotate-start
prompt: Quick smooth whoosh of a heavy stone tower starting to rotate on its axis, low friction rumble

name: fall-start
prompt: Airy descending whoosh of a small ball beginning to fall through open air

name: pass-through
prompt: Bright ascending chime ping as a ball slips cleanly through a gap in a metal platform

name: land
prompt: Solid rubbery thud of a bouncing ball landing on a hard wooden platform

name: smash
prompt: Crunchy shattering crash of a heavy ball smashing straight through a brittle glass platform

name: danger-hit
prompt: Harsh metallic alarm clang with a low thud, a ball striking a red hot danger sector

name: invalid
prompt: Short dull error buzz, a denied action on a mechanical switch

name: undo
prompt: Quick reverse tape rewind swoosh, a brief backwards zip

name: stage-win
prompt: Short triumphant rising brass fanfare, four bright notes, stage complete celebration

name: countdown
prompt: Single clean electronic countdown beep, high and precise

name: achievement
prompt: Sparkling two-note magical unlock chime with a shimmering glockenspiel tail
